text.comment: Holy frag! What happened to this guy?
He'll be fine. We call this an impedance bubble. But we can't hold it for long.
I wish I had time to explain, but we only have a few moments to talk.
There's no time to explain. I'm here to get you out.
I'm not important. But the information I have for you is very important.
Cool your jets a moment.
If you're going to ignore me, I'd rather you just disappear with your magic bubble.
Who are you?

add_player_choice.selectable: if this.$SelectNotRepeatable? then false else true

text.comment: I'm Harper Donel. I've been sent here from a far-off place to get you out of jail.
Okaaaay... keep talking.
I'm a friend. I have a non-jail proposition for you.
So I have friends with magic bubbles. Good to know.
Impedance bubble unstable.
Impedance bubble status green.
Who said that?!
Oh er... just a... computer update.
I need to hurry, and let you know what's going on.
Oh yes. Standard computer voice here. Reminding Harper to hurry up and tell her the deal!
So what's this deal then?
That's a highly advanced artificial intelligence.
We call it... him... the Mission Director.
Yes yes yes. Introductions all made. Now Harper, will you kindly tell her the deal?
So what's this deal then?
I really need to tell you what will happen if you choose to come with us.
Oh my goodness! Kaori, I'm MD. Just the backup on this mission.
Harper. Please tell the poor woman the deal before the impedance bubble collapses or she dies of old age.
So what's this deal then?
I wish I knew exactly.
We live on a space facility that launches us into different times and different places, where we do missions.
You're not exactly selling this bubble girl.
You're not exactly selling this bubble dude.
You're right. Think of it this way...

add_player_choice.selectable: if this.$SelectNotRepeatable? then false else true

text.comment: If you come with me, we will explore the galaxy and time itself.
No. Fraggin'. Way!
We're like... Guardians. Sent by a higher power to right the galaxy's wrongs.
Like you being in jail, for instance.
Now that DOES sound like something I could get behind.
Impedance bubble status red
Impedance bubble collapse imminent! Hurry!
Impedance bubble unstable.
Look. There's more. This is a one-way ticket.
Once we leave this place, you can never come back to this life.
But I have family. Can I even say goodbye?
We don't have that luxury. We either go now, or not at all.
I see. Goodbyes are not an option.
This just isn't possible. But I'm sure they don't want you spending your life here in a cell.
Don't sugar coat it, Harper. Tell me how it really is.
I really wish that were possible. We'll be there to help you through this.
You know you're just a stranger with a magic bubble. You're not my best friend.
Is there anything else I need to know?
This is all a lot to take in so quickly.
Honestly. You're kind of shady. I think I'll take my chances with the enemy I know.
I have a feeling you're gonna get a kick out of dogfighting in a 23rd century scout ship.
Aww. You had me at dogfighting.
Come on, Harper. Let's get out of here. The food sucks anyway.
You and me, Kaori. We're gonna make the galaxy safer for everyone.
But you don't really know that, do you Harper?
Ah, frag it! Take me away from this place. We'll figure it out together.
You're strong, Kaori Chen. I know you can take this head on.
Arent you a charmer! Go one, then. Beam me up to your time machine.
It's decision time. Are you coming or not?
Look. You need to work on your social skills but I hope there's room for two in your bubble. I'm in.
Look, I'm sorry. I've kind of messed this up. This really is your decision.
Too right it is!
Look. You need to work on your social skills but I hope there's room for two in your bubble. I'm in.
Please! If you say no, they're just going to send me back in time to try again.
Again and again until I can change your mind.
Yeah. My mum always told me never to get into time machines with strangers.
Get out of my cell you sociopath, and take your bubble with you.
